versions.content: If a timer channel is configured in "continuous mode": If the timer has reached the target time (timer value = tar get time), the timer shall continue running with the value "0" at next timer tick. So, the time interval of the recurrence is: target time + 1. This interval shall be independently of implementation, e.g. interrupt delays.
